captions_meta.li_hook:
Five red flags that make editors stop reading a press release.
All of them are easy to fix before you send.
li_body: None of these are about writing talent. They are process gaps that a two-minute review would catch.
li_points: A headline with no verb: if nothing happens, there is no news.
The news buried below the fold: lead with it.
Unverified superlatives such as "world's first": journalists check, and credibility drops when they can't.
Long pitches: Muck Rack (2025) found 69% of journalists prefer pitches under 200 words.
A generic contact: name a person who will answer the phone today.
